title: Parameter Superposition baseline vs structured Mirror contexts
hypothesis: On a low-rank correlated task family, shared PSP and learned rank-8 task codes provide useful retrieval; Mirror-specific value requires a held-out quality/storage point better than exact PSP unbinding and the byte-identical generic low-rank code control.
physical_object: one rank-8 shared task basis superposed into one D-dimensional tensor
mirror_coordinate: one learned rank-8 task coordinate decoded in the shared basis
logical_multiplicity: 16 correlated task vectors reconstructed from one shared physical basis

task.task_values: 16 task vectors generated from an 8D shared Gaussian basis plus 0.03 Gaussian residual; held-out Gaussian inputs are separate

controls: Parameter Superposition with fixed seeded Rademacher contexts and exact dot-product unbinding
shared mean vector with task index only
generic learned rank-8 task-code matrix (same capacity and compute as Mirror)

development.allowed: Select shared Mirror/generic low-rank learning rate from [0.001,0.01,0.03] after 1600 Adam updates; all methods/metrics and serializer frozen in amendment A1 before running.

storage.authority: actual torch-serialized inference payload bytes including superposed tensor, context codes, scale, indices, and metadata
paid_objects: all task-specific context vectors or structured codes

success_gate: PSP retrieval NRMSE <0.70, Mirror uses <=60% of independent task-vector bytes and stays within 10% NRMSE of PSP in each fresh world; a Mirror-specific claim additionally requires beating byte-identical generic low-rank coordinates (which may refute specificity).
failure_gate: PSP retrieval NRMSE >=0.30, Mirror fails the quality/byte frontier, or Mirror equals the generic low-rank control without a distinct functional mechanism.
boundaries: Synthetic aligned Gaussian vector tasks only; this is not a neural-network model composition or NLP capability claim.
Learned Mirror contexts are optimized from development task vectors; fresh task IDs and Gaussian inputs are held out.
Useful multiplicity is based on held-out task output error, not combinatorial code counts.

amendment_A1.reason: A0 independent Gaussian vectors made fixed PSP retrieval uninformative and the metric broadcast [n] against [n,1]. A1 changes task distribution to a low-rank correlated family and explicitly evaluates each task separately with paired held-out outputs.
amendment_A1.implementation_correction_A1C1: Initial development detected a residual PSP unbinding multiplier D from the earlier formulation. Corrected to exact dot-product unbinding Wc/||c||^2 before selecting any learning rate or accessing fresh. Initial development rows are retained as excluded diagnostic artifact; corrected A1 rerun reuses only the preregistered development worlds/seeds.
amendment_A1.gate_amendment_A1G1: Before fresh access, PSP utility ceiling changed from 0.30 to 0.70 because corrected development PSP NRMSE was 0.469-0.625 across six seeds. This broadens the screen and is disclosed; success still requires Mirror to match PSP quality and beat its exact-byte low-rank control. Any fresh result is exploratory confirmation under amended gate, not confirmation of the original preregistration.
